notes.title: Thunder Chase is now available in 16 languages!
notes.content:
We have great news. Thunder Chase is now available in 16 languages!

• English
• Turkish
• Simplified Chinese
• Traditional Chinese
• Dutch
• Finnish
• French
• German
• Italian
• Japanese
• Korean
• Norwegian
• Portuguese
• Russian
• Spanish
• Polish

Have fun!
